items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: My grandmother, she was a very sweet woman. I don't know, I always loved her. Everytime she'd come visit us, she'd always bring me a nickle

ctx.x: That was on your mother's side. How about on your father's side?
Yes, I remember very well my father's...uh, uh... I'm trying to think, I forgot the old man's name...
